subject: Post-call: Security & pen-test artifacts + vuln management next steps
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Coleman <ava.coleman@acmehealth.com>, Tom Blake <tom.blake@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Security & pen-test artifacts + vuln management next steps

Thanks again for the 30-min call today — great to meet the Acme security team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

1) Compliance posture
- You mentioned Acme maintains SOC 2 Type II for the platform scope, and that a full report from 2026 can be shared with an NDA. Please confirm the exact scope (in-scope services) and whether the report includes pen-test summaries.
- You also noted HIPAA is applicable for PHI flows; we'll treat that as a requirement for any pilot with patient data.

2) Vendor questionnaire
- Attached is our vendor security questionnaire (Redwood_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx). Request: Could you have your security contact (Ava/Tom) start filling the questionnaire and return by EOD Friday, Aug 6? If easier, we can do a sync to review answers.

3) Pen test report & vulnerability process
- Ask: Acme has an external pentest report from 2026 — would you be able to share a redacted copy for our security review? We are specifically looking for: scope, severity breakdown, CVE references, remediation timelines, and whether a public disclosure policy exists.
- Redwood’s baseline asks: we typically request a 30-day SLA for critical findings, 60 days for high, and a 90-day process for medium/low where applicable. We also run quarterly automated scans on customer-prem workloads and recommend at least annual external pentests. Please confirm if those timelines work for Acme or provide your preferred SLAs.

4) Next ops steps
- If you can share the redacted pen-test and SOC 2 report under an NDA/BAA, Rishi can review and come back with any follow-ups.
- I'll create a HubSpot record and a shared Drive folder (link below) for artifacts.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
https://redwood.ai
From: Ava Coleman <ava.coleman@acmehealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-29T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & pen-test artifacts + vuln management next steps

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clear notes. Quick responses below and I've attached the redacted pen-test as requested.

Compliance posture
- We are SOC 2 Type II (platform scope) with the most recent full report issued in Nov 2026. That report DOES include a high-level summary of the pentest results but not full findings. We can share the full pentest report in redacted form once an NDA is in place.
- HIPAA: yes, PHI flows are in scope for certain product integrations — we require a BAA for any PHI access.

Vendor questionnaire
- We'll start the questionnaire today; Tom will take point and return it by Aug 5.

Pen test report & vuln timelines
- Attached: Acme_PenTest_2026_redacted.pdf (contains CVE references and severity buckets; IPs/user data redacted).
- Our internal remediation SLA is: 14 days for critical, 45 days for high, 120 days for medium/low (these are target windows; we can discuss exceptions). Formal disclosure policy: vulnerabilities are disclosed to affected customers after remediation verification; public disclosure requires consent from legal.

Docs attached: Acme_PenTest_2026_redacted.pdf

Next steps
- We will sign the NDA/BAA (I'll route to legal). Once signed, I'll provide the SOC 2 package.

Best,
Ava Coleman
Sr. Information Security Manager, Acme HealthTech
ava.coleman@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0199
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Coleman <ava.coleman@acmehealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-29T10:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & pen-test artifacts + vuln management next steps

Thanks Ava — appreciate the quick turnaround and the redacted report. A couple of clarifying items from a technical/ops perspective: 

1) Redaction level
- The attached PDF looks fine for our security review, but can you confirm CVE identifiers are preserved (we need them to map to our vulnerability scanner). If any finding references are removed, please provide an index mapping to severity buckets.

2) Remediation SLAs
- Your 14-day SLA for critical is very strong and acceptable. For high findings, we typically operate with a 60-day SLA on customer-managed integrations; 45 days is workable if there is clear prioritization. We will capture the agreed SLAs in the MAP.

3) Scanning cadence & evidence
- Redwood runs authenticated dynamic scans quarterly for integrated customers and recommends annual 3rd-party pen tests. For SOC 2 evidence, we'll need a statement of scope and either the SOC 2 report or the bridge letter if the period doesn't fully overlap.

4) Disclosure expectations
- Please confirm whether Acme allows sharing anonymized CVE details in a joint notification (we ask this so incidents affecting mutual customers can be coordinated). If legal requires no joint notifications, please provide the standard legal language or point of contact.

I'll wait for the NDA/BAA before requesting the SOC 2 packet. Lauren — once we have the SOC 2, I can run a gap analysis and return a short list of any technical follow-ups.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Tom Blake <tom.blake@acmehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ava Coleman <ava.coleman@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-29T14:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & pen-test artifacts + vuln management next steps

Rishi — quick note on disclosure: legal prefers we don't co-publish vulnerability details without a mutual agreement. We are open to coordinated customer notifications that redact customer-identifying details, but any joint public advisory requires legal review and sign-off. I'll ask legal to draft a short MOU for coordinated disclosure and share the point of contact.

Also: we will preserve CVE ids in the redacted doc and we'll provide a mapping if anything else is obfuscated. Expect the SOC 2 packet once NDA/BAA complete.

Tom Blake
Head of InfoSec Operations, Acme HealthTech
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Coleman <ava.coleman@acmehealth.com>, Tom Blake <tom.blake@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-30T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & pen-test artifacts + vuln management next steps

All — thanks for the responses and the pen-test attachment. Quick operational items from our side so we can keep momentum: 

- I'll upload the questionnaire answers and the MAP draft to the shared Drive folder and attach the HubSpot deal (link above). 
- Monica, can you prepare a short MAP doc that lists agreed SLAs (Critical:14d, High:45d, Medium/Low:90–120d) plus scanning cadence (Redwood quarterly authenticated scans + annual external pen test) and circulate for signature?
- Ava/Tom — once the NDA/BAA is signed, please share the SOC 2 bundle. If legal would like an MOU for coordinated disclosure, we can accept that and add a line in the MAP referencing the MOU.

Next meeting: propose Aug 10 at 10am PT to review the completed questionnaire and MAP. I'll send a calendar invite after hearing availability.

Thanks — Lauren
